age.Description: Age of the participant at time of testing

RosenbergScale.Description: Score to the Rosenberg scale to assess the subjects' self-esteem (Rosenberg, 1965)

EMG28-amotivation.Description: Score to the global motivation scale (Guay et al,2003), assessment of the amotivation

EMG28-extrinsic-externReg.Description: Score to the global motivation scale (Guay et al,2003), assessment of the extrinsic motivation from external regulation

EMG28-extrinsic-identifReg.Description: Score to the global motivation scale (Guay et al,2003), assessment of the identified extrinsic motivation

EMG28-extrinsic-introjReg.Description: Score to the global motivation scale (Guay et al,2003), assessment of the introjected extrinsic motivation

EMG28-intrinsic.accomplishment.Description: Score to the global motivation scale (Guay et al,2003), assessment of the intrinsic motivation linked to the accomplishment

EMG28-intrinsic.knowledge.Description: Score to the global motivation scale (Guay et al,2003), assessment of the intrinsic motivation linked to the knowledge

EMG28-intrinsic.stimulation.Description: Score to the global motivation scale (Guay et al,2003), assessment of the intrinsic motivation linked to the stimulation

VMIQ2-externalVisualImagery.Description: Score to the VMIQ-2 scale (Roberts et al., 2008) to assess the subjects' ability to perform a visual motor imagery task from an external perspective

VMIQ2-InternalVisualImagery.Description: Score to the VMIQ-2 scale (Roberts et al., 2008) to assess the subjects' ability to perform a visual motor imagery task from an internal perspective

VMIQ2-KinaestheticImagery.Description: Score to the VMIQ-2 scale (Roberts et al., 2008) to assess the subjects' ability to perform a kinaesthesic motor imagery task

STAI_YA-session1.Description: Score to the STAI-YA scale (Spielberger et al., 1983) to assess the subjects' anxiety at the beginning of session 1

STAI_YA-session2.Description: Score to the STAI-YA scale (Spielberger et al., 1983) to assess the subjects' anxiety at the beginning of session 2

STAI_YA-session3.Description: Score to the STAI-YA scale (Spielberger et al., 1983) to assess the subjects' anxiety at the beginning of session 3

STAI_YA-session4.Description: Score to the STAI-YA scale (Spielberger et al., 1983) to assess the subjects' anxiety at the beginning of session 4

BCI-Performance-session1.Description: BCI performance during session 1 is measured as the percentage of trials in which the subject successfully hit the target with the moving cursor during each run

BCI-Performance-session2.Description: BCI performance during session 2 is measured as the percentage of trials in which the subject successfully hit the target with the moving cursor during each run

BCI-Performance-session3.Description: BCI performance during session 3 is measured as the percentage of trials in which the subject successfully hit the target with the moving cursor during each run

BCI-Performance-session4.Description: BCI performance during session 4 is measured as the percentage of trials in which the subject successfully hit the target with the moving cursor during each run
